subcategory_description: A documented AI policy sets direction for developing and using AI systems
The AI policy is aligned with other organizational policies such as security and privacy
The AI policy is reviewed at planned intervals and when things change
Roles and responsibilities for AI are defined and allocated
People can report concerns about AI systems through a defined process
Resources needed across the AI system life cycle are identified and documented
Data resources used by AI systems are documented
Tooling resources used by AI systems are documented
System and computing resources used by AI systems are documented
Human resources and competencies for AI systems are documented
A process exists to assess the potential consequences of AI systems
Results of AI system impact assessments are documented and retained
Impacts on individuals and groups of individuals are assessed
Societal impacts of AI systems are assessed

subcategory_description: Processes for responsible design and development are defined and documented
Requirements and specifications for new or changed AI systems are documented
Design and development decisions are documented
Verification and validation measures and acceptance criteria are defined and applied
A deployment plan exists and requirements are met before deployment
Operation and monitoring of AI systems are defined and performed
Technical documentation is maintained for each relevant audience
Event logs are recorded at the appropriate life cycle phases
Data management processes for developing and enhancing AI systems are defined
How data is acquired and selected for AI systems is documented
Data quality requirements are defined and data meets them
Data provenance is recorded across the data life cycle
Criteria for preparing data are defined and documented
Users receive the information they need about the AI system
Interested parties can report adverse impacts of the AI system
A plan exists to communicate AI system incidents to users
Obligations to report information about the AI system to interested parties are determined
Processes for responsible use of AI systems are defined and documented
Objectives guiding responsible use of AI systems are identified and documented
AI systems are used according to their intended use and documentation
Responsibilities are allocated between the organization and its partners and suppliers
Suppliers' services and products align with the organization's approach to responsible AI
Customer expectations and needs are considered for responsible AI
